nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Wash AP+ Gentle Foaming Moisturizing Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily and oily-combination skin report the wash cleans thoroughly without stripping, with some saying it balanced oil production and helped acne.
segments.dry: Many reviewers with dry, very dry, or eczema-prone skin describe it as moisturizing and non-tightening, but several others with dry skin report the opposite, saying it dried their skin out, caused peeling, or felt like a sunburn.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those who are also acne-prone, describe it as gentle yet effective, though one notes it can occasionally feel drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it is the only wash that doesn't irritate or trigger eczema/rosacea, while others report itching, rashes, redness, or breakouts.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her sixties reports it removes makeup well and leaves skin soft, with compliments on her skin.

concerns.aging: A mature reviewer reports soft skin and compliments after use, but this is not tied to a specific anti-aging claim.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the wash relieves dryness, flakiness, and tightness, some saying they can skip lotion afterward; however, a notable minority say it made their skin drier, tight, or peeling, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say redness and irritation resolved or did not occur, including one whose long-standing red, scaly patches cleared within a week; others report the wash caused new redness or a rash.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema frequently report the wash calmed flare-ups and stopped itching without irritation; a couple with eczema or rosacea still report burning, breakouts, or a rash.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes ongoing dark spots unrelated to the wash's effect, and another with hormonal acne reports improved texture and reduced breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts and calmer skin; a smaller number report new or worsened breakouts, including cystic-type acne and body/facial breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the wash does not leave skin greasy and can help balance oil, with no dissenting reports on this specific point.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser breaks or is not recyclable
Causes tingling or burning on application

extraits.texte: I have been using the Toleriane hydrating gentle cleanser for normal to dry skin with great success, I have rosacea and my skin need lots of extra hydrating. When I saw La Roche-Posay made a cleanser for dry to extra dry skin I thought it would be even better. But no it just burned my skin and made it so dry and tight, it looks like it is peeling from a sunburn. Just terrible
I wanted to love this because its very hydrating, but it created a rash on my cheeks by the 2nd wash. Same thing happened to my daughter who has eczema/sensitive skin.

My esthetician who waxes me told me to switch to a new body wash as we discovered fragrance and ingredients were causing redness irritation and dry skin, even though it was a popular moisturizing wash. I needed to use moisturizer twice daily and my skin was still dry and flaky. I switched to this and in ONE use my skin changed. No texture or dryness, and so much hydration. Absolutely no fragrance or irritation whatsoever. I feel clean and i can go WITHOUT body lotion because of this body wash. I no longer have redness ingrowns or irritation and my skin looks and feels healthier. Will repurchase for life.

extraits.titre: Works so well for my oily acne-prone skin!
extraits.texte: I have skin that tends to get oily as well as acne. However, keeping my skin better moisturized has balanced out oil production. My skin feels nourished after using this wash. My acne has also improved by using a gentle wash without any harsh stripping washes. The formulation is well-balanced in regard to its cleaning power and the hydration it delivers. I also use this on my body sometimes. I shave with a single-blade razor, which gives a very close shave, meaning it's basically dermaplaning my skin. It's also very easy to nick yourself. On nights that I shave, I like to use this wash since it's so gentle and nourishing for my skin.

for most of my life, I've had oily skin. in the last couple of years, parts of my face have become deserts while other parts remain oily. I've had red, dry, scaly splotches appear between my eyebrows, on my cheeks, and around my nose. I have tried so many cleansers and moisturizers, but none seemed to help. until I tried this. within a week of using this cleanser twice a day, my face completey cleared up. the dryness, the redness--all gone! all the issues I have been dealing with for years just disappeared within a week of using this product. truly could not recommend it enough!

I have really sensitive skin and also have eczema, so even the "gentle" brands like Aveeno were leading to dryness and irritation. I tried this wash and I don't regret it! It is very moisturizing and gentle. I haven't tried it on my face, only my body, but it is a great product. It foams up well, but you have to use a couple of pumps. That is my only complaint. Either way, I will continue to buy this!

extraits.titre: Not great for my face but GREAT for body wash
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and rosacea. It broke me out just a tiny bit on the face for rosacea acne, but. might work in the winter when it comes, just too hot here in TX now. It was great as a body wash though, even though I think it says face wash. I only have one other body wash I can use right now that doesn't break me out, and this worked great for that purpose. I read it from another reviewer so tried it, and YES now my new favorite body wash for sensitive dry skin.
